descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S09 Generate and Regenerate leave the task list exactly as it was (PR #50)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generate AI Note never re-marks or removes tasks (PR #50) (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Each chart has one open task, one task closed by Save & Extract and one ticked done by hand; then the encounter text is extended with a sentence that answers the open task

When Snapshot Task Export (A); tap Generate Note & Finish, snapshot (B); tap Regenerate Note, snapshot (C). Same in Nursing Home. After the run the harness reads diagnostics:list

Then B and C show the same tasks in the same state as A: nothing added, removed, duplicated or re-marked; the open task stays open even though the new text answers it (only Save & Extract closes tasks)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U4: the task part of B and C equals A (sameTaskSectionAs, including each row's control: 'Mark task done' vs 'Undo — move back to pending'), so a re-marked, dropped or duplicated task fails even though its text is still on the page. Each checkpoint has the open task above and both completed ones below the completed heading (anchor pairs, oracleRules 8). …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (task section compared before and after Generate and Regenerate)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
